question: When her beloved knocked at night, what reason did the woman first give for not getting up?
options: She had taken off her robe and washed her feet
The door was locked and she had no key
She was afraid of the watchmen
She did not know who was knocking
explanation: In Song of Songs 5:3 she says she has taken off her robe and washed her feet, and asks if she must put them on and get them dirty again.
